authoring.method: Questions authored from the frozen document inventory, outlines and Corpus.read passages before any comparison rankings were viewed. No Corpus.search, embedding or model calls were used.
authoring.status: Prospective probe; all 18 questions may be used in this comparison. Not a permanently unexposed holdout.

categories.plain_language: User task phrased without the target API identifier.
categories.exact_api: Question explicitly names the relevant API or field.
categories.workflow: A user task requiring complementary documentation across at least two pages.

authoring.grouping: Nine paired information needs; category variants are correlated and must not be reported as 18 independent needs.

reference_policy.nugget_matching: A nugget is covered when at least one acceptable passage is retrieved. Each listed quote is an exact substring of that passage text in the frozen snapshot.
reference_policy.scope: These references are a curated relevance set, not an exhaustive relevance judgment for every corpus passage. Unlisted passages may still be useful; report exact reference recall with this limitation.
reference_policy.alternatives: Alternatives are interchangeable support for the same nugget, not extra mandatory reads. Single-reference nuggets have one located direct support passage.
reference_policy.answer_judging: Nuggets guide retrieval measurement. Optional answer assertions describe requested behavior; no particular wording, citation ID, code length or reference-page choice is required when the answer has valid read evidence.
reference_policy.provenance: Navigation snippets, titles and outlines are not supporting evidence. Source references must not be injected into agent queries.
reference_policy.per_page_cap: The current search interface caps results at two sections per page. Some multi-nugget questions therefore cannot achieve full curated-reference coverage in one search. Keep the same cap across comparison arms and report achievable reference-coverage ceilings; do not treat the shortfall caused by this cap as a ranking defect. The agent can still read additional sections after navigation.

cases.query: For client.add_cost, are prompt_token_cost and completion_token_cost per token or per million tokens, which llm_id should I use, and how do I make the rate apply from a chosen date?

nuggets.description: Register llm_id with prompt and completion costs expressed per token, converting quoted per-million rates.

acceptable_passages.quote:
The three required fields are `llm_id`, `prompt_token_cost`, and `completion_token_cost`.
`llm_id` is the name of the LLM (for example, `gpt-4o`). `prompt_token_cost` and `completion_token_cost` are the cost per token for the LLM. If the LLM prices are specified per million tokens, convert the value.

* **`llm_id`**: The ID of the LLM. eg "gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18"
* **`prompt_token_cost`**: The cost per prompt token. eg .0005
* **`completion_token_cost`**: The cost per completion token. eg .0015

nuggets.description: Use effective_date to specify when a rate applies; it defaults to the current date.

acceptable_passages.quote: You can also set `effective_date` to a datetime to make the cost effective at a specific date. This defaults to the current date.
* **`effective_date`**: Defaults to the current date. A datetime.datetime object.

assertions.description: Explains that prompt_token_cost and completion_token_cost are per-token rates and should be converted from per-million pricing when necessary.
Uses the model identifier for llm_id and explains effective_date, including its current-date default.

A sub-agent can itself delegate to another sub-agent. Each `start_subagent` call nests under whatever span is currently active in OTel context.

nuggets.description: Sub-agents inherit the active conversation_id and remain in that conversation.

acceptable_passages.quote: Sub-agents inherit the active conversation's `conversation_id`, so they're grouped with the rest of the conversation in the **Agents** view.

assertions.description: Explains that start_subagent attaches to the currently active OTel span, including a current sub-agent for nested delegation, rather than requiring an explicit parent span argument.
